outcome: quality of intrapartum care (intrapartum fetal heart rate monitoring, breastfeeding within 1 hour of birth, skin-to-skin contact, health worker hand hygiene practices)
cohort: Pregnant women enrolled in the SUSTAIN and REFINE studies with a gestational age of 22 weeks or more and a fetal heart sound at admission, from nine hospitals in Nepal.
finding: During the COVID-19 lockdown in Nepal, institutional childbirth decreased by over 50%, while institutional stillbirth and neonatal mortality rates significantly increased, and the quality of intrapartum care generally declined, although some behaviors like skin-to-skin contact and hand hygiene improved.
